sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: After a 10-year transformation, the glorious cathedral-like Smithfields market is now telling the capital’s story. Our architecture critic enters a world of jewels, axes, DJs and dog races – with unposh coffee from Syd’s century-old stall ‘All piazza, no punch’: Jonathan Jones reviews the exhibits ‘All the grit and glitter,” trumpets a big illuminated sign on the roof of the old Smithfield general market, beaming out as if advertising a raunchy burlesque show. It is the jazzy tagline of the new-look London Museum, which has gone from being marooned on a roundabout in an armpit of the City to taking over this prime Victorian market complex, following an arduous decade-long transformation. The slogan is fitting for a museum that displays everything from priceless Tudor jewels to a lump of congealed fat and rags dredged from a Whitechapel sewer. Just as the colossal fatberg was scraped from the murky depths, so has the former market hall (and its extensive warren of basement vaults) been meticulously scoured and scrubbed up. 音樂串流平台Tidal宣布，禁止純AI生成的歌曲上架，預計刪除2700萬首這類歌曲。目前AI歌曲佔Tidal歌曲庫的6.3%，這次之後會全部清光。Tidal表示，如果歌曲只是「有AI協助製作」、不是整首由AI生成，還是可以留著。
